text: セキチク　ジムは　からくり　やしき　みえない　かべで　しきられてる！

structure.jp: セキチク　ジムは　からくり　やしき
structure.en: Fuchsia Gym is a house of tricks

structure.jp: みえない　かべで　しきられてる！

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The られ in the verb turns 'divide' into 'be divided': the thing is on the receiving end. しきられてる = 'is partitioned'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows the state something is left in; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. しきられてる = 'is in a partitioned state'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing tells you what is used to do the action. みえない　かべで = 'with invisible walls'.
